subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: When one Antigravity model family is exhausted but another remains usable, should automatic menu-bar display and merged highest-usage prioritize the blocked family or the usable family?
rationale: Current main and existing regression expectations prefer a usable lane, while this PR intentionally reverses that behavior; source inspection cannot determine the desired product semantics.

options.title: Prioritize blocked family
options.body: Surface the exhausted recognized lane consistently so the binding family and actionable reset remain visible.

options.title: Preserve usable family
options.body: Keep the current default so automatic display represents a lane where the user can still work.

options.title: Split by display context
options.body: Use blocked-lane semantics for reset-focused output and usable-lane semantics for percentage or highest-usage output.

recommendation.title: Prioritize blocked family
recommendation.body: Surface the exhausted recognized lane consistently so the binding family and actionable reset remain visible.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the explicit person asked to confirm this user-facing default behavior.
